answers.value: Both statements are correct - buying 78 gm needs at least 7 coins, while weighing 78 gm on a balance needs only 4.

For statement 2, weighing lets you place coins on both pans, so 50 + 25 + 5 = 80 on one pan against the 78 gm object plus a 2 gm coin on the other balances with just 4 coins. The two statements are worded differently on purpose - 'buy' means the coins must add up, 'weigh' allows subtraction - and if both meant simple addition the two statements would be exact opposites, which would make options C and D impossible by construction.

Conclusion-2 (S greater than Q) therefore follows, since Q is at most T and T is strictly less than S. answers.value: Liberty.

Personal safety (A) and the safe functioning of body and mind (B) are named in the passage, but as the conditions the state provides so that free reason becomes possible - they are means, not the last end; communal harmony (C) is at best a by-product of men not injuring their neighbours.
